title: Technology Analyst - SAP Native HANA & Palantir.
jobDescription: Job Description Date: 17/July/2026 Role : Technology Analyst - Data Product - SAP Native HANA Number of positions : 1 The Mission Airbus has started its Digital journey. The objective is to transform the company and to prepare it for the future. This transformation includes new global governance, new ways of working and the implementation of digital business services and platforms managed by Airbus. Are you passionate about IT, experienced in SAP Technologies and convinced by the business added value of digitalization? The Airbus’ Information Management (IM) Function is looking for an SAP expert developer to join its teams. If you enjoy challenges and working with highly motivated people in a dynamic, fast-paced and agile environment, come and join us to deliver innovations that accelerate the next generation of digital products. The Role Airbus’ Information Management (IM) Function is seeking a SAP HANA and Data Product Lead. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex quality business processes and high-performance technical architecture. As a Data Product Team Lead, you will collaborate with fellow architects, development teams, and other stakeholders to design resilient, feasible, and scalable solutions for our customers. You will also prioritize features that build out the architecture runway, and align with standards. To be successful in this role, you need to be a team player with a strong technical background and excellent communication skills. What You Bring Experience: 7 to 8+ years of solid professional experience in SAP Native HANA development, with a heavy emphasis on advanced WebIDE for HANA and custom SAPUI5/Fiori architectures. Technical Mastery: Proven expertise in creating and consuming SAP OData/RAP services, CDS view development, ABAP 7.5+ syntax, Calculation views (Native HANA and WebIDE) and RFC. Agile Mindset: Comfort working in distributed, cross-functional teams using Scrum or DevOps methodologies, with a clear focus on stable, "first-time-right" hotfix and feature deliveries. Customer Focus: Excellent communication and analytical skills, with a proven track record of directly engaging international business partners (specifically European customers) to translate business evolution points into technical solutions. Qualifications & Experience As a Data Product Team Lead, he/she should have a very good understanding of business processes and technical architecture of Airbus SAP landscape and define/suggest SAP best practices and Golden rules. Your area of responsibility will extend to deep technology root cause analysis, performance improvement and source code auditing. The candidate will join the Quality Product and Service Line structure providing digital solutions to manage quality business processes throughout the Aircraft Engineering, Manufacturing and Customer Services organizations. As such, he/she needs to have a strong customer focus. He/she needs to have regular business interactions for identifying & understanding the Business Evolution Points. The candidate will work in an international, distributed and multi-functional team using an agile mind-set and methodology. At least seven (7+) years of professional experience developing software with ABAP and Native HANA Development or equivalent technologies. Proven track record of providing technical guidance, leading software teams, and making critical technical decisions. Strong, hands-on experience in code optimization, system performance tuning, and refactoring complex codebases as well as working with relational databases (SQL). Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in SAP UI5 application development following standard design guidelines. Demonstrated experience diagnosing, debugging, and resolving software issues in live production environments. Good technical communication skills, with the ability to confidently articulate complex architectural concepts to both technical team members and business stakeholders. Experience working with cloud environments. Hands-on exposure to In-App extensibility, Fiori Administration, JavaScript, JSON, and XML. Performance Tuning – ability to analyse and fine tune existing programs. Excellent communication skills as required to engage customers on requirements and delivery. Good problem solving and analytical skills Main Responsibilities Define architectural direction, evaluate complex technical trade-offs, manage technical debt, and establish robust development practices for the SAP HANA and Skywise(Pallantir) ecosystem. Establish operational excellence standards and lead comprehensive code reviews to ensure secure, high-quality deliverables, while championing the strategic integration, mentorship, and team-wide adoption of AI-powered tools and best practices in AI-assisted engineering. Actively guide, support, and nurture the professional growth of junior and intermediate team members, fostering a collaborative, modern, and highly engaged engineering culture. title: Senior Lead Technology Analyst, SAP Integration
jobDescription: Job Description Role: Senior Lead Technology Analyst, SAP Integration Relevant Experience: 12+ years Number of positions: 1 Date: 09/03/2026 About the Position Are you passionate about IT, experienced in software development techniques, operations management, and convinced by the business added value of digitalization in the ERP domain? Airbus has embarked on a digital journey to transform the company and prepare it for the future by enabling ERP systems in a digitally connected world. This transformation includes new global governance, agile ways of working, and the implementation of digital business services and platforms. We are looking for a Senior Lead Technology Analyst, SAP ERP Platforms to join our location in Bangalore, India. This role is part of the Digital Functions and is responsible for the day-to-day management of the ERP CoE Platforms scope. Success in this position requires strong international collaboration, a deep understanding of modern SAP ecosystems, and a passion for delivery, innovation, and service excellence. As a Senior Lead Technology Analyst- SAP Integration, the candidate will be the definitive technical authority for the design, harmonization, and integration of highly complex, global IT landscapes spanning SAP and Non-SAP systems (On-Premise, Multi-Cloud, and Hybrid applications) utilizing state-of-the-art integration technology. This is a strategic leadership and enterprise architecture role focused on defining the integration roadmap, leading the global BTP transformation, and establishing a scalable Integration Factory Model. The ideal candidate will transition the organization from bespoke development to a standardized, high-velocity integration delivery engine. You will not only architect complex solutions but also govern the Center of Excellence (CoE), mentor technical leads, and partner with senior business stakeholders to ensure our SAP integration landscape enables seamless S/4HANA global transformations. The candidate will operate in an international, distributed, and multi-functional agile environment, driving enterprise-level standards and innovation. Qualification & Experience 12+ years of extensive experience in the architecture, development, optimization, and governance of complex enterprise integrations, with a primary focus on SAP PO and SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Advanced Event Mesh). 5+ years of proven experience functioning as an Integration Architect on large-scale, global implementations. Integration Factory / CoE Experience: Demonstrated success in designing, establishing, and running an Integration Factory Model or Integration Center of Excellence (CoE) to industrialize integration delivery, standardize patterns, and optimize offshore/nearshore delivery pods. Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Transformation Mastery: Deep expertise in leading enterprise-wide legacy modernizations and global BTP transformations, utilizing assessment tools, automated accelerators, and risk-mitigated cutover strategies. Advanced BTP & EIC Capabilities: Exceptional proficiency with the SAP BTP ecosystem, including BTP Cockpit enterprise account modeling, Cloud Connector architecture, end-to-end setup and management of Edge Integration Cell (EIC), and multi-region high-availability setups. API & Event-Driven Architecture: Mastery of API-led connectivity and Event-Driven Architectures (EDA), with strong knowledge of API Management policies, lifecycle management, and Advanced Event Mesh. Technical Depth: While operating at an architectural level, must retain advanced, hands-on proficiency in Groovy Scripting, Java, XSLT, Web Services (REST, OData, SOAP), and complex message mapping. Enterprise Security: Deep understanding of Zero-Trust architecture and security protocols/metrics, including advanced Encryption (PGP, SSL/TLS), and Identity Authentication (mTLS, SAML, OAuth2, JWT). Strategic Vision: Continuous understanding and active anticipation of SAP roadmaps and strategies regarding integration, composable ERP, and AI-driven automation in integration spaces. Roles Integration Ownership: Own the end-to-end integration architecture for the global landscape. Define and enforce enterprise-grade integration patterns, documentation standards, and architectural blueprints. Integration Factory Leadership: Design and operationalize the Integration Factory model. Define intake processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks to scale integration delivery across multiple scrum teams. Strategic Transformation Lead: Take full technical and strategic responsibility for the global BTP transformation program, ensuring zero business disruption and optimal re-architecture of legacy flows. Business Partnership: Act as the primary technical point of contact for Leadership, enterprise architects, and global business unit leaders to define integration scope, roadmap, and financial optimization. Platform Governance: Enforce strict governance standards by establishing platform metrics for stability, security compliance, system health, and architectural integrity across the hybrid landscape. Responsibilities Design Scalable Solutions: Transform complex global business requirements into scalable, resilient technical designs, ensuring all edge cases, high-volume performance metrics, and security requirements are rigorously addressed. S/4HANA Transformation Support: Act as the lead integration authority for a global template SAP S/4HANA transformation, rolling out BTP-IS alongside the new core to ensure seamless, real-time data orchestration. Establish Secure Hybrid Connectivity: Architect, set up, and manage secure, high-throughput connectivity across complex multi-cloud and On-Premise landscapes using SAP Cloud Connector, rigorous Edge Integration Cell (EIC) installations and configurations, and appropriate networking protocols. Quality Assurance & Code Review: Oversee technical code reviews across the Integration Factory pods to ensure all developments align with architectural blueprints, quality standards, and Airbus/corporate best practices. High-Level Escalation: Serve as the ultimate escalation point for deep-dive troubleshooting and maintenance of critical production interfaces, driving root-cause analysis (RCA) and long-term resolution for high-compliance landscapes. Team Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship, upskilling, and guidance to senior developers, technology analysts, and offshore teams to foster a high-performance culture within the integration domain. Success Metrics Success will be measured in a variety of areas, including but not limited to: Consistently ensuring the on-time delivery and high quality of platform projects and services. Fulfillment of SLAs, service availability, and quick reaction to operational issues. Bringing innovative, cost-effective solutions to the ERP CoE. Successful bridging between EU and India to ensure seamless strategic and operational collaboration. Demonstrated individual and team competency development in SAP Integration. title: Technology Analyst , SAP BTP
jobDescription: Job Description Role: SAP Integration Specialist Date: 09/03/2026 Relevant Experience: 6 to 8 years Number of positions: 1 Description As a SAP Integration Suite specialist, the candidate must understand the design, harmonization and integration of complex IT landscapes between SAP and Non SAP (On-Prem and cloud applications) using state-of-the-art integration technology. The candidate should have a good experience in SAP PO and BTP Integration suite application. This is a technical specialist role focused on the development, migration, and maintenance of our SAP integration landscape. The candidate will be responsible for building complex interfaces in SAP Integration products and contributing to the technical migration from SAP PO to SAP BTP Integration Suite. As part of this role candidates ensure technical standards are met through peer reviews and platform governance metrics for stability, while providing technical mentorship to the wider team. The candidate will work in an international, distributed and multi-functional team, using mainly Agile mind-set and methodology (SCRUM). Qualification & Experience 6+ years in development and optimization of inbound and outbound interfaces based on SAP PO and SAP BTP Integration Suite. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Deep Experience in SAP PO development, maintenance and optimization. Proficiency with SAP BTP services including Cloud Integration, API Management, Advanced Event Mesh, and Cloud Connector. Expertise in API management developments and strong knowledge of the Policies. Good knowledge on Tenant Administration and BTP Cockpit sub account management. Experience in Edge Integration Cell, S/4 transformation and PO-to-BTP IS migration is a significant advantage. Strong knowledge of Web Services and API technologies (REST, OData, XML/JSON, SOAP, XSLT). Advanced proficiency in Groovy Scripting, Java, and User Defined Functions (UDFs). Solid understanding of On-Premise, Private Cloud, and Public Cloud architectures to establish correct communication protocols and secure integrations. Deep understanding of security protocols and metrics, including Encryption (PGP, SSL/TLS), Authentication(mTLS, SAML, OAuth2 etc). Experience in managing the availability and stability of production environments including system maintenance, performance optimization and ensuring 24/7 reliability of critical interfaces in a high-compliance landscape. Strong communication skills to interact directly with business stakeholders, gather functional requirements, and translate them into technical specifications. Roles: Drive the build of complex, high-volume interfaces using modern integration patterns. Take technical responsibility for moving PO flows to BTP without business disruption. Act as a technical point of contact for business units to define integration scope and requirements. Conduct technical code reviews to ensure all team developments meet quality standards and security compliance. Enforce governance in platform standards by monitoring security compliance, system health and architectural integrity across the landscape. Responsibilites: Develop and maintain end-to-end integration flows using BTP Integration Suite services and SAP PO, leveraging Groovy, XSLT, and Graphical Mapping. Perform deep-dive troubleshooting and maintenance for production interfaces. Transform business requirements into scalable technical designs, ensuring all edge cases and security requirements are addressed. Enforce naming conventions, documentation standards, and architectural patterns across the landscape. Apply deep knowledge of integration patterns to define and implement solutions according to Airbus standards, ensuring architectural consistency and reusability. Establish secure connectivity across hybrid landscapes (On-premise to Cloud) using appropriate protocols and SAP Cloud Connector. Continuous understanding and awareness of the SAP roadmaps and strategies with respect to Integration. This role will support a global template of SAP S/4 transformation with BTP-IS rollout, ensuring seamless integration and compliance with best practices. jobDescription: About Organization: As a proven leader in the global aerospace sector, Airbus designs, produces and delivers innovative solutions with the aim to create a better-connected, safer and more prosperous world. A commercial aircraft manufacturer, with Space and Defense as well as Helicopters Divisions, Airbus is the largest aeronautics and space company in Europe and a worldwide leader. Airbus Engineering in India has evolved as the key contributor for the success of various programs. The center has strong capabilities in the areas of structural analysis, loads, aerodynamics, avionics software design and testing, system simulation, digital mock-up and system installation etc. In the avionics software team, we perform end to end software development activities starting from high level requirements definition to the certification of the software applying product line technology, component based development, formal methods etc. Job Role: Avionics Software Integration & Verification: The individual will be responsible for Integration, Verification and Validation of Safety critical Real Time Embedded Platform software for the avionics domain conforming to DO 178 B/C standard. The individual is expected to provide technical leadership and should have working exposure to complete Software Verification Activities. Job Responsibilities: The individual will be responsible for performing below activities for Avionics Software: - Define, document, and execute the overall Software Verification Strategy and Test Plan in accordance with DO-178B/C objectives. - Perform integration of complex software components/subsets, manage software builds, and maintain configuration control across life-cycle baselines. - Design, configure, and maintain advanced test rigs and environments, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HSIT), Software-in-the-Loop (SWIT), and simulated test benches. - Author, review, and execute high-level and low-level Software Test Cases and Procedures (Functional, Performance, Boundary, and Robustness testing). - Perform structural coverage analysis (MC/DC, Statement, Decision coverage) to ensure complete requirement verification. - Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and debugging for complex issues identified during internal integration or customer/stakeholder testing. - Implement test automation frameworks to increase verification efficiency and continuous integration pipelines. - Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and drive verification best practices across multi-site global teams. Job

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Leader
jobDescription: The Logistics / Supply Chain leader is responsible for ensuring the timely availability of parts and materials required for the final assembly line of helicopters. The role involves proactive management of the supply chain to prevent shortages, monitor part flows, and mitigate any potential delays or issues that could impact production. The coordinator will interface with production, work preparation teams, and operational procurement to ensure the efficient and seamless delivery of parts to the assembly station. Key Responsibilities: Parts Availability Management: Ensure the continuous availability of parts required at the final assembly station, preventing potential delays or shortages. Monitor and prioritize missing parts, ensuring they are addressed promptly to minimize production disruptions. Collaborate with the foreman on the assembly line and work preparation teams to identify and resolve any parts availability issues. Part Flow Monitoring: Track the flow of parts to the assembly line and anticipate potential issues, including errors, losses, or damaged parts. Identify, monitor, and address any aleas (delays, issues, or disruptions) in the parts supply chain. Report on missing or delayed parts and provide alternate solutions to avoid delays in the assembly process. Communication & Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between production, the platform, and the Operational Procurement Officer. Communicate critical missing part requirements to the Operational Procurement team and ensure timely procurement actions are taken. Maintain close communication with work preparation teams to resolve technical issues that may affect the availability of parts. Problem Solving & Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify potential risks in the parts supply chain and take appropriate action to prevent future issues. Work with the Operational Procurement Officer to secure commitments for the timely delivery of critical parts. Provide alternate solutions when critical parts are missing, ensuring minimal impact on the final assembly line. Reporting: Provide regular reports on the status of parts availability, including any missing parts and the actions taken to resolve them. Track and report on the flow of materials, highlighting any discrepancies, errors, or inefficiencies that may arise. Collaboration: Ensure effective coordination between various stakeholders, including the foreman, operational procurement, and work preparation teams. Support the overall supply chain strategy to ensure alignment with production schedules and deadlines. Qualifications & Requirements: Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). Experience: Proven experience in logistics or supply chain management within a manufacturing or assembly environment, preferably in the aerospace or helicopter industry. Experience with parts management, inventory control, and production coordination is highly desirable. Skills & Competencies: Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to quickly address and resolve supply chain issues. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work effectively across teams. Attention to detail and accuracy in tracking parts and reporting on missing components. Ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office and experience with logistics management software/systems (e.g., ERP, SAP). Certifications & Training: Relevant certifications in logistics or supply chain management are a plus (e.g., APICS, CSCP, etc.). title: Technology Analyst - Test Automation Tricentis Tosca
jobDescription: Description: We are seeking an experienced SAP Test Automation Consultant to drive continuous testing for our complex SAP landscapes using Tricentis Tosca. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining codeless, model-based automation suites that validate end-to-end SAP business processes (e.g., Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report). You will play a critical part in ensuring the stability of our SAP ecosystem—whether during routine release cycles, continuous updates, or major S/4HANA transformation initiatives. Key Responsibilities: End-to-End Automation: Design and build resilient, automated test cases across various SAP interfaces, including SAP Fiori, SAP GUI, SAP Web Dynpro, and SAP APIs (OData, RFC, BAPI). Cross-System Workflows: Automate complex, end-to-end business processes that span across SAP and non-SAP connected applications (e.g., Salesforce, web portals, third-party logistics). Test Case Design (TCD): Utilize Tosca’s TestCase Design module to create data-driven, parameter-driven test templates that maximize coverage while minimizing the number of scripts. Execution & Maintenance: Run automated regression suites using Tosca Distributed Execution (DEX), analyze execution logs, and perform quick root-cause analysis on failures. Test Data Provisioning: Create and manage dynamic test data strategies for SAP environments using Tosca Test Data Management (TDM) or by leveraging SAP standard BAPIs/IDocs to generate synthetic data. Risk-Based Testing: Work with SAP functional consultants and Business Analysts to map business requirements to test cases, ensuring high-risk SAP modules are heavily prioritized. CI/CD Integration: Integrate Tosca automated suites into DevOps pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins) to support continuous testing for SAP transports and releases. Defect Management: Collaborate with SAP ABAP developers and functional teams to report, reproduce, and track defects using tools like Jira, qTest, or SAP Solution Manager (SolMan). Qualifications & Skills: Experience: 3 to 6 years of overall experience in software testing, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience using Tricentis Tosca in an SAP environment. SAP Interface Expertise: Strong practical knowledge of automating SAP UI technologies (SAP GUI, Fiori/UI5) and web services/APIs. Tosca Core Skills: Proficiency in standard Tosca functionalities: Modules, TestCases, TestCase Design (TCD), ExecutionLists, and Requirements management. Business Process Knowledge: Familiarity with standard SAP modules (e.g., SD, MM, FICO) and how data flows between them during core business processes. Certifications (Highly Preferred): Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist 1 & 2 (AS1 & AS2). Test Design Specialist 1 & 2 (TDS1 & TDS2) is a strong plus. Solid analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot complex SAP data or automation framework issues. Clear communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical automation concepts and business-focused SAP functional teams. Experience working in an Agile/Scrum delivery model. Good to have skills: Tricentis LiveCompare: Experience using LiveCompare for AI-driven change impact analysis to identify exactly what needs to be tested after an SAP transport or upgrade. SAP Solution Manager (SolMan) / SAP Cloud ALM: Experience integrating Tosca test suites with SAP SolMan or Cloud ALM for requirement traceability. S/4HANA Migration: Prior involvement in automated testing for an SAP ECC to S/4HANA migration project. Basic understanding of SAP ABAP debugging to assist in defect triage. In India, the Digital Strategy, Governance & Transformation team plays a key transversal role promoting synergies between multiple domains across Airbus worldwide with a flexible and adaptable approach which helps in sharing best practices, architecture, innovation, operational excellence and being efficient with cost, quality and time. A technical lead at Airbus acts as the technical representative of the product, overseeing its entire technical path. In this context, the Technical Lead will join the Enterprise Architecture PSL responsible for Process, Methods, Tools, and Data (PMTD) at Airbus. Coordinate the functional and technical integration across all components: MyPortfolio, Alfabet, MuleSoft Gateway, and Skywise. Define the team's best coding practices, technical standards, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Jenkins, OpenShift, and Terraform. Mentor and coach junior and mid-level developers, conduct code reviews, and ensure solution quality. Define and champion the overall test strategy, advanced testing scenarios, and automated monitoring of test execution. Act as a technical liaison with Enterprise Architects, business stakeholders, and other development teams. Qualification & Experience: Required: A Bachelor/ Master Degree in Computer Science or a relevant field with overall 12+ years of hands-on software development experience. 5+ years in a senior or technical leadership role with demonstrated experience leading development efforts for enterprise applications. Expert-level knowledge and proven experience with the MuleSoft integration stack (API Gateway, DataWeave, Anypoint Studio) and setting API governance policies. Mastery of the core application stack: Angular, Node.js/Nest.js, Typescript, and MongoDB. Deep architectural experience with Data Lake/Data Platform integration (e.g., Skywise), including designing and optimizing large-scale ETL/ELT data pipelines. Expertise in SQL and strong experience designing schemas for highly relational structured databases, critical for the future state architecture. Expertise in the DevOps stack: Containerization (Docker), Orchestration (OpenShift), CI/CD (Jenkins), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). In-depth knowledge of Enterprise Architecture and Application Portfolio Management (APM) concepts. Proven ability to lead technical design, mentor team members, and manage technical debt. Extensive experience working in agile environments (SAFe, Scrum). title: AI/ML Engineer - Methods & Tools
jobDescription: AI/ML Engineer - Methods & Tools Team: Airbus India - Engineering Methods & Tools About the team: We are a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in a multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems. The team is composed of people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing the latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have. Some examples of the digital solutions are Data driven designs of wiring, Automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based products aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. We are also involved in developing web-based solutions to encapsulate and automate different workflows such as flight test planning, business management etc. Some of the tools developed are used in the areas of Aircraft Safety analysis and Engineering Business Data monitoring etc. We work in Agile/Scrum/SAFe processes in developing state of the art digital products for the areas mentioned above. The Role: What You’ll Do As an AI/ML Engineer, you will bridge the gap between data science and software engineering. You will own the lifecycle of machine learning models from conceptualization to production deployment and monitoring. Design & Build: Develop, optimize, and deploy scalable ML/DL models (including computer vision, NLP, or LLMs). Scale & Deploy: Architect robust ML pipelines (MLOps) to automate model training, testing, and deployment. Collaborate: Work closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to integrate AI capabilities into our core platform. Optimize: Fine-tune models for latency, throughput, and resource utilization in a cloud or edge environment. Innovate: Stay at the forefront of AI research and evaluate how new technologies/methodologies can be applied to our product roadmap. What We’re Looking For (Requirements) Experience: 3+ years of professional experience as an ML Engineer, Data Scientist, or Software Engineer with focus on AI. Education: BTech/MTech/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). Programming Power: Strong proficiency in Python (and/or Go) with clean, production-grade coding standards. ML Stack: Good expertise with frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras and libraries like Scikit-Learn, Pandas, and NumPy. Computer Vision: Solid understanding of CV techniques and frameworks. Experience with object detection, image segmentation, or image classification using tools like OpenCV, YOLO, or Hugging Face vision models. Data Engineering: Experience with Data engineering and orchestration tools (MLFlow, DVC, Spark, Kafka) or Data Platforms (Snowflake/Foundry). LLMs (Optional but preferred): LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases, experience with RAGs and fine-tuning open-source LLMs. Cloud (Optional but preferred): Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Knowledge Graphs: Ability to design, build, and query Knowledge Graphs. Familiarity with graph technologies, ontologies, and graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune, NetworkX, or Graph Neural Networks). Bonus Points If You Have A strong portfolio of GitHub projects or contributions to open-source AI/ML libraries. Experience with model deployment (ONNX, TensorRT) Soft Skills Very good communication and presentation skills Ability to demonstrate effectiveness in holding conversations with customers in a customer-centric outreach. Demonstrate ability to work as a team in a highly collaborative and cross-cultural environment. Why Join Us? You will work at the exciting intersection of code and the physical world. Your work won't just live in a database—it will directly influence how real-world aerospace systems are designed, simulated, and built. We offer a collaborative environment, cutting-edge projects, and ample opportunities for professional growth. jobDescription: Description Digital within Airbus is a Transnational Organisation mirroring the Industrial landscape. Digital is currently undergoing a major transformation programme focussing on Product and Technology Service teams with an end-to-end (E2E) accountability and full responsibility for the value proposition. As SAP GTS Solution Architect for S4 Transformation, the candidate would be responsible for the end-to-end solution design, implementation, and governance of the SAP Global Trade Services (GTS) platform. This individual acts as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for all global trade processes within the SAP ecosystem. This role involves translating complex business requirements for import/export compliance, customs management, and trade preference into a robust, scalable, and efficient SAP GTS solution. The architect will lead project teams, collaborate with business stakeholders, and ensure seamless integration with SAP S/4HANA (or ECC) and other third-party systems.
minimumQualification: Technical & Functional Expertise Mandatory: 9+ years of SAP experience with at least 5-7 years of hands-on experience in SAP GTS. Proven expertise in configuring and implementing all major SAP GTS Functionalities within the Custom module (Ex. Inbound, Outbound, Intrastat, Reconciliation) Multiple full life-cycle SAP GTS implementation experiences, preferably in a lead architect role. Deep understanding of the integration points between GTS and SAP S/4HANA (or SAP ECC) SD, MM, and FICO modules. Strong knowledge of global trade regulations and compliance processes (e.g., export controls, customs valuation, rules of origin). Highly Desirable: Experience with SAP S/4HANA for International Trade (in addition to standalone GTS). Knowledge of ABAP development, debugging, BADI implementations and user exits relevant to GTS. Experience with integration technologies like SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), IDocs, and API management. Strong leadership and mentoring skills to guide development and functional teams. Superior analytical and problem-solving abilities to manage complex business requirements. Proven project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field Responsibilities Solution Design: Lead the Solution design of all SAP GTS modules, including Compliance Management (e.g., Sanctioned Party List screening, embargo checks, legal control), Customs Management (e.g., import/export declarations, customs procedures, broker integration), and Preference Management (e.g., free trade agreement handling, vendor declarations). Develop and maintain the solution roadmap for SAP GTS, aligning it with business goals and IT strategy. Create detailed solution blueprints, functional specifications, and technical design documents. Implementation & Project Leadership: Lead and guide technical and functional teams during full-cycle SAP GTS implementations, upgrades, and rollouts. title: Flight physics ARtificial intelligence and Machine learning Data Scientist - FARMer
jobDescription: Flight Physics CoC is looking for a Machine Learning and Data Scientist Engineer to join our Flight Physics FARM team. The objective of the Flight Physics “FARM” team is to reinforce the technical and operational leadership in the 1G Artificial Intelligence ecosystem and be in position to support all the Flight Physics business needs. You will join the transnational Core Team, composed of 3-5 full-time data scientists and AI specialists, serves as the central technical execution engine and primary Doers (FARMer) tasked with moving AI concepts to working prototypes. This team translates high-level business needs into technical requirements, develops initial validated models, and drives the adoption of standardized MLOps and POD platforms to ensure technical consistency across the Flight Physics organization. Critically, they also partner with the domains and Technical Experts to define and execute the Verification & Validation (V&V) strategy essential for future certification. Accoutabilities: The central team of data scientists and AI specialists in 1GZT is accountable for: Technical Expertise: They are the deep-level experts responsible for selecting, developing, and applying advanced AI techniques, such as LLMs, CNNs, and creating surrogate models. Framing & Prototyping: Their primary focus is on rapid prototyping and feasibility studies for high-impact use cases (like the "Vibration Killer" lighthouse projects). They translate high-level business needs into technical requirements and develop the initial, validated AI models. Centralized Standards: They are responsible for driving the adoption of standardized tools and platforms like MLOps and POD for training and deployment, ensuring technical consistency across the Flight Physics organization. V&V Partnership: They work with the domains' Technical Experts to define and execute the Verification & Validation (V&V) strategy for the prototypes, which is critical for future certification. Main activities Data Analytics: Apply your data science expertise to process, analyze, and interpret flight physics data. Process Improvement: Identify and drive process improvements, build compelling business cases, and test, mature, and industrialize these improvements to enhance our capabilities. Community Building: Build and foster the FARM community in flight physics to promote exchange, mutual support, and co-creation. Networking: Connect with data science networks both within and outside Airbus to share knowledge and best practices. Team Support: Support and collaborate with aerodynamic engineering teams in their daily tasks, especially during peak workloads from industrial programs such as wind tunnel testing, numerical simulation, analysis, and modeling. Leadership: Mentor and inspire technical teams, introducing data science methods to drive innovation and efficiency in engineering organizations. Prototyping for Industrialization: Frame and build high-impact prototypes (e.g. Vibration Killer, OAD Surrogates). Prepare for hand-over for industrialization by building up MLOps and POD deployment workflows Domain Consulting: Act as a "detached" specialist within Aerodynamics, Loads, or Mass domains to identify pain points, define business cases (ROI), and translate engineering needs into technical AI requirements. Data Governance: Establish data ownership, improve data traceability, and ensure that "fuel for AI" is accessible, clean, and standardized across 1G. Supplier management: Manage external partners on technical deliverables for computing infrastructure, data engineering where needed. Desired skills and qualifications Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven track record in data science and analytics with at least 5 years of professional experience, including experience in AI and big data analytics. Proficiency in Python and fluency in the core data-science stack (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, Jupyter). Experience with SQL and basic proficiency in C/C++ and Fortran are additional assets. Familiarity with the design and maintenance of robust ETL pipelines (Airflow, Spark, or equivalent) and databases (on-premises or in cloud). Hands-on experience with major cloud analytics stacks (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) for large-scale processing and model serving. Experience implementing experiment and model tracking for reproducibility and suitable for regulatory reviews (e.g., MLflow, DVC). Knowledge in Flight Physics in the aerospace context is mandatory 5+ years Experience in aircraft design, characterization, simulation is mandatory. Experience in the aerospace industry or a related field will be valuable. In particular, experience with engineering or physics-based simulations is a strong plus. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on data-driven decision-making. Ability to explain complex methods and the strategic value of data science to both engineers and senior managers. Integrity, confidence to speak up, and a commitment to act with integrity. Evident ability to learn and grow fast. Good analytical capabilities, assertive and stress resilient. Proven experience mentoring technical teams and introducing data-science methods in engineering organizations. Supplier management experience (Mandatory) Advanced proficiency in English. Willingness to travel as needed. Commitment to compliance and integrity. title: Developer - DevOps
jobDescription: Job Title: DevOps Developer Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be instrumental in optimizing our software development lifecycle, from coding and deployment to maintenance and updates. You will champion automation, foster collaboration, and ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems. Team's Core Mission/Purpose: AIRINA – AIRbus Enterprise INformation Archive – is our latest archiving solution, provided globally to all our business divisions within Airbus - Commercial Aircraft, Helicopter, Defense and Space. AIRINA will gradually replace the current legacy archives. More efficient new technology will enable unprecedented improvements in reliability, quality, and performance. AIRINA will bring together People, Process, Content, and Data and represents another step towards Airbus' transformation into a data-driven company. The Platforms team in India (aka Cadence Team) plays a crucial role in enabling our development efforts. We are dedicated to the end-to-end maintenance and support of our core infrastructure, including Camunda, MarkLogic, Splunk, Ansible, Jenkins, OpenShift, and a comprehensive suite of DevOps tools, ensuring seamless operations for our development teams. Key Responsibilities: CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, implement, and maintain robust and scalable CI/CD pipelines to automate software builds, testing, and deployments. Integrate various development, testing, and deployment tools into the CI/CD workflow using Jenkins. Manage and optimize artifact repositories using Artifactory for efficient storage, versioning, and distribution of binaries and dependencies. Implement and manage static code analysis gates using SonarQube & CheckmarxOne within the CI/CD pipeline to ensure code quality and identify vulnerabilities early. Ensure continuous integration of code changes and efficient delivery of software. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement and manage infrastructure using Ansible. Centralized Playbook Repository - All Ansible playbooks, roles, and inventory files are stored in a centralized Git repository. Modular and Reusable Roles - We heavily utilize Ansible roles to break down complex configurations into smaller, manageable, and reusable units. Jinja2 Templating for Dynamic Configurations - For configurations that require dynamic values or environment-specific settings, we use Jinja2 templating within our Ansible playbooks and role templates. Inventory Management for Environment Segregation - Our Ansible inventory files define our infrastructure, categorizing hosts into groups based on their environment. Provision and manage cloud infrastructure (Openshift) ensuring security, cost-effectiveness, and optimal performance. Containerization & Orchestration: Work with container technologies like Docker for packaging applications. Manage and orchestrate containerized applications using Kubernetes System Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Build and sustain critical monitoring, logging, and alerting infrastructure with Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk to deliver real-time visibility into application and system performance. Proactively identify and resolve technical issues, perform root cause analysis of production errors, and implement preventive measures. Design procedures for system troubleshooting and maintenance. Collaboration & Communication: Collaborate within a SAFe Agile Release Train (ART) to ensure alignment of DevOps practices with program objectives and PI (Program Increment) goals. Collaborate closely with our European counterparts. Act as a liaison between development, operations, and other cross-functional teams to foster a culture of collaboration and shared responsibility. Communicate technical issues and solutions effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving development practices. minimumQualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 4 to 6 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform preferably Openshift. Expertise with CI/CD tool - Jenkins Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python or Shell). Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool - Ansible Expertise in containerization (Docker) and Kubernetes orchestration, with practical experience in crafting Helm charts. Hands-on experience with Artifactory for artifact management and binary repositories. Hands-on experience in implementing and managing SonarQube for code quality and security analysis. Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools - Grafana, Prometheus & Splunk Understanding of networking concepts & system administration (Linux/Windows). Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative team spirit. title: Group Manager - Connectivity
jobDescription: Job Description Date: 05/06/2026 Group Manager: Connectivity (Network) Solutions About Position: Are you passionate about IT & its application to Enterprise Connectivity & Infrastructure, experienced in modern networking technologies, and convinced by the business added value of the digitalization of Network & Security Domain functions to support global operations? Airbus is looking for a Group Manager Digital Connectivity to join the Bengaluru, India location. Position Overview: Lead the Digital Connectivity team within the Digital Infrastructure & Platforms Department. The role focuses on delivering, securing, and operating robust network infrastructure and enterprise connectivity solutions. Success requires strong disciplinary leadership, a deep background in modern network architecture, and an exceptional track record in end-to-end service delivery. The successful candidate will establish team goals by identifying, evaluating, and understanding the business and digital strategy & technical trends. He/She will accomplish the team results/performance by communicating job expectations, planning, monitoring, coaching, and leading the team in the right direction. Qualification & Experience Education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communications, or a relevant engineering discipline. Experience: 12+ years in Network Engineering and IT Operations, including proven disciplinary leadership, team management, and global IT service delivery management. Domain Knowledge: Professional background in managing critical enterprise infrastructure is required (Aerospace industry background is a plus). General understanding of Engineering IT processes is expected; highly specific enterprise networking and service delivery domain expertise is mandatory. Technical Stack: Advanced architectural proficiency in modern network ecosystems, specifically: LAN: Campus & Data Center switching (e.g., Cisco Nexus, Arista), VxLAN, EVPN, High Availability protocols, Software-Defined Access (SD-Access) & cloud connectivity. Wi-Fi: Wireless & Industrial: Wi-Fi 6/7 architectures and deployments (e.g., Cisco Catalyst/Meraki, Aruba), IoT, 4G/5G and next-generation shopfloor/Digital Factory solutions. . WAN: SD-WAN architectures (e.g., Cisco Viptela, Versa, Palo Alto Prisma), MPLS, Internet transport optimization, Cloud On-Ramp, and global routing protocols (BGP, OSPF). Network Security: Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW - Palo Alto, Fortinet), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Network Access Control (NAC/ISE), and secure VPN solutions. Automation & Cloud: Cloud networking (AWS/Azure) and Network Automation (Python, Ansible, NetDevOps). Preferred Certifications: Expert/Professional Network Certifications: CCIE (Routing & Switching/Enterprise), CCNP Enterprise, Aruba Certified Mobility Professional (ACMP), or equivalent. Security Certifications: PCNSE (Palo Alto), CISSP, or Fortinet NSE 7/8. Service & Project Management: ITIL v4 Managing Professional, PMP, or SAFe Agilist. Methodologies: Advanced knowledge of ITIL service management frameworks, Agile/SAFe frameworks, and DevOps/NetOps practices. Travel: Willingness to travel if needed on short notice. Language & Soft Skills: Business-fluent English and strong communication skills for continuous collaboration with European partners. Core Responsibilities Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and develop network engineering teams ensuring alignment with global product roadmap. Execute staffing strategies via direct hiring and partner/supplier management. Network Harmonization: Drive large-scale network harmonization initiatives to standardize legacy infrastructures, consolidate disparate environments, and unify connectivity frameworks across global locations. Regional Accountability (APAC or similar continental Operations): Direct the setup, migration, and day-to-day delivery of network operations across multiple countries within the continental footprint, ensuring local compliance, operational governance, and seamless cross-border regional delivery. BCP / DR Readiness & Testing: Own the strategy, readiness, and resilience of the network infrastructure via robust Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR). Establish schedules for, orchestrate, and validate regular live DR simulation tests to ensure zero-downtime failover capabilities. Operations & Service Delivery: Lead high-availability network operations, ensure maximum infrastructure uptime, and enforce strict SLA/KPI fulfillment alongside agile project delivery, and mitigate local/regional infrastructure risks. Technical Steer: Enforce network engineering and security standards, driving the transition toward modern, software-defined, and cloud-integrated network architectures. Intercultural Orchestration: Act as the strategic and operational bridge between the Bengaluru hub and European partners, aligning local execution with global business objectives. Empowerment & Culture: Empower team members by delegating authority and encouraging individual responsibility for goals. Cultivate a workplace environment that mirrors the organization's strategic objectives. Logistics & Governance: Administer operational logistics including work schedules, on-call support rotations, and leave management. Ensure clear, transparent, and effective communication across the team. Escalation Management: Actively resolve critical network incidents/escalations, perform root-cause analysis (RCA), and maintain agreed-upon performance metrics. Global Alignment: Serve as an intercultural liaison to strengthen corporate relationships across global teams. Coordinate with global partners and stakeholders to ensure network project and operations alignment. Continuous Improvement: Apply enterprise-wide perspectives to identify and address emerging business infrastructure needs. Regularly integrate lessons learned to drive multi-axial continuous improvement. Collaborate with senior management and project boards to provide progress updates. Success Metrics Success will be measured in a variety of areas, including but not limited to: Agile mind-set, collaborative way of working, and rapid reaction times during critical network outages or infrastructure emergencies. Flawless SLA fulfillment, network uptime, MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) reduction, and service availability. Consistently ensuring the on-time, within-budget delivery and quality of network infrastructure projects. Bringing innovative, cost-effective, highly scalable, and secure connectivity solutions. Achieving high internal customer, engineering department, and business stakeholder satisfaction. Ecosystem synergy: Flawless operational coordination and strict adherence to governance models with the local IT organisation. title: Product Owner - TrajOpt
jobDescription: A vacancy for a Product Owner - Trajectory Optimizer (TrajOpt) has risen within Airbus India in Bangalore. You will join the Airline Sciences team within the Digital department. The Airline Sciences team is part of the Airbus Digital department. It is composed of engineers, data scientists, developers, business analysts from all around the world. Its objective is to act as an advisor to bring airline operational representability in all Airbus activities (pre-design, detailed design, marketing, guarantees, services). By combining aircraft models, simulations, operational research, data analytics and artificial intelligence, the Airline Sciences team is able to deliver realistic aircraft performances, network schedules and cost evaluation. By analyzing historical data (weather conditions, navigation database and airport data), the Airline Sciences team can precisely match real world conditions and provide the most accurate airline model. Following best IT practices and Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), the Airline Sciences team developed the Airline Digital Twin, a web application and API hosted on AWS, that can be used across all Airbus divisions. Working toward the same objectives, Airline Sciences is divided into multifunctional teams gathering business specialists, engineers and developers. Another team, fully IT, is responsible for the CI / CD processes and infrastructure of the application, as well as providing support to the other teams. As a Product Owner - TrajOpt, you will serve as a highly specialised product lead responsible for contributing to the product vision and roadmap, driving continuous improvement, connecting with customers for business needs, owning the product backlog, supporting value-delivery and get/give feedback. You will be the reference point and you will drive the product development in Airbus India. We are looking for a high energy, team player interested in joining a team of Product Owners/Managers, data scientists, developers, and business experts. This position will report to a Group Manager within Airbus India. Passion for technology and problem solving are a must have. Qualification & Experience: We seek out curious minds. We value attention to detail, and we care deeply about outcomes. We’re looking above all for passionate people, eager to learn, willing to share, establishing innovative ways of working and influencing culture change. Are you ready to share this exciting challenge with us? Manage and prioritise the Product Backlog for TrajOpt, along with the Product Manager Supporting the Product Team in Delivering Value through TrajOpt Product Responsible for Continuous Improvement through Testing and Continuous Release Management. Proactively and frequently, received, apply and provide feedback to all stakeholders related to TrajOpt Product Participate and Facilitate some of the common PI ceremonies like PO/PM Sync-up, Epic Assessment and Prioritization and also product-specific ones like Backlog Refinement Sessions, Features assessment and dividing them further into User stories, etc. Accountable for designing and reporting key metrics and performance indicators related to the Product to the management team Accountable for driving the Performance monitoring activities for the related products Competencies: MUST Have: Working experience on Agile and SAFe methodologies / willing to upskill rapidly on the same Knowledge and experience as a Product Owner on IT product / applications for at least 3-4 years for a multinational organisation Good IT skills on medium to large scale products and applications related to - development, testing, Code Configuration Management, Software Development Lifecycle Experience and expertise on the Aerospace domain related Software products, aerospace domain knowledge, etc. Experience with AWS S3, ECS, SQL Database management, Java or C++ preferred Knowledge on Airbus aircraft models/variants Knowledge on or systems related to Aircraft trajectory, Aircraft Performance, Navigation Database, Flight Panning Regulations, data and inputs related to the same, navigational systems / data, etc. Quality management (agile preferred) Resource and Stakeholder Management experience Excellent communication and presentation skills Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills. title: End 2 End Operations Quality Assurance
jobDescription: You will ensure that the company’s operational processes (develop, fulfil, support and source) comply with the quality assurance requirements, standards and internal or third party certification/approvals as defined in the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality plan for hardware/software/services. You will devise and validate the hardware/software/services' control and inspection plan and ensure its proper implementation (using traditional and new methods, e.g. virtual/augmented reality). You will monitor the conformity & attestation status. Where deviations occur, you will be involved in the handling of the non- conformance including analysis of the deviations, monitoring of the corrective and preventive actions, as well as contributing to the improvement of the quality standards. As such, you will collect, analyze, visualize and interpret the relevant process and/or in service performance data using available means (manual and automatic) to identify early process variations and to take effective actions by means of root cause analysis to mitigate and resolve any quality issues by supporting a robust PPS method application. You will provide the evidence of conformity to processes and requirements to Programme Quality Assurance to ensure the satisfaction of customer requirements. In new product / process / service development you will ensure that operational processes' lessons learnt and risk analysis are done early, and that relevant preventive quality standards are used in order to mitigate the risks and that a rigorous Development Plan (multi- functional reviews, maturity gates, ...) is followed. You will implement & operate Prevention Means (such as APQP, DFMEA) . In case of software development you will ensure software and data integrity, verify and validate/certify the software and data in compliance with the appropriate standard for its specific application, e.g. on-board software, ground test software for prototype, small series production, simulation models, decision making support systems. If applicable (within Procurement Quality), you will carry out supplier development and surveillance, supporting the qualification of supplier manufacturing processes and setting applicable requirements to suppliers. If authorized, you will support the company's certifications and interfaces with external quality authorities (ISO, IAQG, EASA, etc.,). KEY DELIVERABLES: Control and Inspection Plan, Product/Service Conformity for a given domain, Non Conformance Analysis and Action Plan, Supplier and Development Assurance Plan, APQP Key Business Deliverables (when owner). KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: to demonstrate conformity of processes and requirements for a given domain to Programme Quality Assurance and External Authorities (when authorized), to drive non conformity management at domain level for Programme Quality Assurance. jobDescription: Job Title : A.I. Lead - Airbus Innovation Centre Job Summary: Airbus Innovation Centre India & South Asia (AIC) is one of the only three innovation centres for Airbus outside the European Union. AIC collaborates with a number of stakeholders both internal and external to develop innovative and bleeding edge products with a particular focus on digital and AI topics. We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled AI Lead to lead our team of data scientists and data analysts in the development of cutting-edge AI products within the aviation field. The ideal candidate should possess a minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience working with Large Language Models (LLM), Computer Vision, and various open-source machine learning models. The AI Lead will be responsible for guiding the team's technical direction, ensuring successful project outcomes, and driving innovation in the application of AI technologies. Drive the development of AI models and algorithms to solve complex aviation challenges, such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and optimization of operational processes. Apply a deep understanding of system engineering principles to ensure AI solutions integrate seamlessly within aviation systems and adhere to safety and regulatory standards. Mentor and guide team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. In-depth knowledge of system engineering principles, with the ability to apply them to complex projects within the aviation domain. jobDescription: Are you a visionary leader passionate about operational excellence, business processes, and convinced by the business value of a highly reliable digital backbone? Airbus has started its digital journey to transform the company and prepare it for the future. As part of this transformation, the Quality Product Service Line (PSL) acts as the guardian of the ERP ecosystem, ensuring that every release—from large-scale SAP S/4HANA migrations to local enhancements—meets the highest global standards of reliability and performance for the business. As a champion for the ERP Transformation within the Quality Management domain, you will ensure that process quality is "built-in" across all Airbus domains, from manufacturing to customer services, while steering the culture toward innovation, modern validation frameworks, and advanced data analytics. Foster an inclusive, high-performance, and "Quality First" culture. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary point of contact for DEL/DEM/DEF India leaders to tightly synchronize quality gates with engineering and manufacturing roadmaps. Deep functional understanding of SAP core modules: Quality Management (QM), Materials Management (MM), and Production Planning (PP). Automation Frameworks: Knowledge and experience with tools like Tricentis Tosca Strategic Partner & Vendor Management: Demonstrated success managing "Make/Buy" models, driving offshore partner factories to high-efficiency delivery metrics. Aerospace Domain Knowledge: Good grasp of aviation Quality Certification, compliance standards, and strict traceability protocols. title: Group Manager - IAM DevSecOps Practice
jobDescription: Job Description Group Manager: Identity & Access Management (IAM) DevSecOps Practice Date: 11/05/2026 Location: Bengaluru, India About Position: Are you passionate about IT security, access governance, and its application across a global enterprise? Are you experienced in modern cloud-native security paradigms and convinced by the business added value of embedding automated Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevSecOps practices across a complex product landscape? Airbus is looking for a Group Manager IAM & DevSecOps Practice Lead to join the Bengaluru, India location. Position Overview: Lead the global Identity and Access Management (IAM) engineering team within the Enterprise CyberSecurity & Infrastructure Department. Beyond direct operational delivery, this critical role serves as the global Practice Lead for all SREs and DevSecOps professionals across the entire IAM landscape. The scope encompasses securing and driving resilience across both commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) integrations and bespoke internally-built (Make) applications. Success requires exceptional disciplinary leadership, deep identity-centric security expertise, and the capability to foster a high-performance culture of automated, secure engineering. The successful candidate will establish team goals by identifying, evaluating, and understanding the business strategy & technical trends. He/She will accomplish the team results/performance by communicating job expectations, planning, monitoring, coaching, and leading the team in the right direction. Qualification & Experience Education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a relevant engineering discipline. Experience: 12+ years in Cyber Security, Identity Management, and IT Operations, including proven disciplinary leadership, team management, and global platform ownership. Domain Knowledge: Professional background in managing critical enterprise scale environments is required (Aerospace industry background is a plus). Highly specific expertise in Identity Governance, Enterprise Security Architectures, and global practice leadership is mandatory. Technical Stack & Domain Expertise: Architectural proficiency in modern identity and deployment ecosystems, specifically: IAM Core: Single Sign-On (SSO), Federation (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0), Customer/Enterprise IAM (e.g., Okta, Ping Identity, Azure AD/Entra ID), Directory Services, and Privilege Access Management (PAM - e.g., CyberArk). IGA & Compliance: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA - e.g., SailPoint), lifecycle management, and automated access provisioning/de-provisioning. DevSecOps Automation: Continuous security integration (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), Infrastructure as Code (IaC - Terraform, Ansible), Policy as Code (Open Policy Agent), and automated CI/CD security gating. SRE Frameworks: Continuous monitoring, observability (e.g., Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus), error budgets, automated incident remediation, and high-availability architecture for identity services. Product Landscapes: Managing and securing mixed portfolios spanning global COTS platforms (enterprise software deployments) and custom Make cloud-native applications. Preferred Certifications: Security & Identity Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or advanced vendor-specific certifications (Okta Certified Professional, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator). SRE & DevOps Certifications: Certified DevSecOps Professional, AWS/Azure DevOps Engineer Expert. Service & Project Management: ITIL v4, PMP, or SAFe Agilist. Methodologies: Advanced knowledge of Agile/SAFe frameworks, SRE principles (SLA/SLO/SLI management), DevSecOps maturity matrices, and Zero Trust security models. Travel: Willingness to travel to Europe for up to 1 month p.a., if needed on short notice. Language & Soft Skills: Business-fluent English and strong communication skills for continuous collaboration with European partners, product owners, and engineering leads globally. Proficiency in German is a plus. Core Responsibilities Team Leadership & Practice Guild: Manage, coach, and develop the local IAM engineering team. Serve as the global Guild/Practice Lead for SRE and DevSecOps engineering across IAM PSL, driving capability models, standardization of blueprints, and talent upskilling across disparate product teams. Global IAM Operations: Ensure high-availability, low-latency identity service operations (strict SLA fulfillment) and secure access management across all global corporate touchpoints. COTS & Make Security Governance: Oversee the secure onboarding and structural lifecycle management of all COTS packages and custom Make applications spread across the global Airbus landscape, ensuring strict alignment with security baselines. Technical Steer: Enforce modern identity engineering and SRE standards, driving the absolute transition toward automated, shift-left DevSecOps principles and cloud-native cloud identity architectures. Intercultural Orchestration: Act as the strategic and operational bridge between the Bengaluru hub and global European partners, unifying engineering methodologies across global product boundaries. Empowerment & Culture: Empower team members by delegating authority and encouraging individual responsibility for system reliability and security goals. Cultivate a workplace environment that mirrors the organization's strategic digital objectives. Logistics & Governance: Administer operational logistics including global shift rotations, follow-the-sun operational structures, and leave management. Ensure clear, transparent, and effective communication across the team. title: Certification Engineer - Structure & Cabin Safety
jobDescription: Description of the job: Certification may be one of the best kept secrets in Engineering. Perceived as purely regulatory by some, this discipline in fact provides a complete overview of the aircraft development process, from the initial project application to the continued airworthiness of the in-service fleet. As Cabin Systems Certification Engineer, you will work in the Cabin and Cargo perimeter. This dynamic team, composed of Certification Engineers, Certification Managers and Experts, currently based in India and Hamburg, forms part of the Certification Technical Directorate (CTD). This team provides technical expertise in the field of cabin and cargo certification. It contributes to Type Certification (TC), change to TC, operational approval, rulemaking and customer support activities. Job scope (Tasks & accountabilities): Within this department, the jobholder will join the Cabin Safety Certification Team, which covers the Cabin installations, layout modifications, seats, galley, placards certifications The Jobholder exercises the legal privileges granted by EASA under Part 21 Subpart-J and act as Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE), ensuring that the minor and major changes to Type Certificate are delivered on time and on quality, and their approval received on time. In addition to leading mods, jobholder will be in charge of defining and negotiating the applicable certification basis, approving the mod classification, ensuring that the compliance demonstration is complete from an airworthiness perspective and performing the final airworthiness review. The jobholder guarantees the Airworthiness of the design changes defined by Airbus, reporting airworthiness issue to a Chief Airworthiness Engineer. Main problems to be solved in the position: The requirements for the Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) for the Change Approval process are: Allocates the changes to him/herself in the Airbus tools (Aircam) as Airworthiness mod leader Reviews the change dossier from the Design Office, classifies the change with regard to part 21 criteria. Within Airbus tool (ACC2). Appraises the design change, identifies the applicable requirements within Airbus tool (ICC) and verifies the compliance to applicable requirements provided by the Compliance Verification Engineer (CVE), if relevant. Completes the Modification Approval Summary in order to approve the Change within ICC, as Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) or communicate specific refusal to the CVE and Design responsible. Record the Change approval in Airbus tool (ACC2). The Engineer must master the Airworthiness and technical knowledge covering the various changes he/she will have to approve as DAE. The changes cover most of Airbus commercial A/C programs requiring a knowledge on all concerned programs in term of airworthiness requirements but also design. Drumbeat the A/C delivery schedules, indeed the changes must be approved in due time to support A/C deliveries. When the change is for installation on an in service A/C the schedule is driven by the Service Bulletin targets. Means made available: Access to all the tools: AirCAM, ACC2, ICC-ACP, NECTAR, CPH Access to the Certification Technical Directorate adequate share folders and drives Delegation process related documentation (and specific training). Major end purposes: Attain Signature Delegation (Check / Approve/ Refuse) in order to deliver Change approvals in line with Program’s expectations. Required Domain Expertise (skills): Graduate/Post Graduate Engineer (Aerospace Engineering / Mechanical Engineering) Several years of professional experience in design or in a cross-functional role within cabin and/or cargo systems. The engineer has a proven experience on large aircraft and preferably on Airbus products. This experience is gained from areas such as maintenance, support or design activities. Technically competent with the design principles used to the compliance data. Knowledge on airworthiness Part-21 Subpart-D and on CS25/JAR25/FAR25 systems requirements is desirable. These experiences will reinforce the back ground of the candidate, his/her capacity in understanding, integrated design and airworthiness of an aircraft. The position has an Airworthiness function, the following requirements are a plus: Engineer should be knowledgeable of the Airworthiness domain, on process, product and technical requirements and integrated aircraft design. In addition, should be able to question and to understand application of technical airworthiness requirements. Should have a sound knowledge of Product Design. Conversant with the roles and responsibilities of a Type Certificate holder operating under a Design Organization Approval granted by EASA. Experience: 7 - 12 years. Soft skills: You are recognized for being a team player, autonomous and customer-oriented with strong communication skills. You have problem-solving approach You speak English. You are able to communicate with the team, to listen but you are able to decide on your own. You are able to alert your management in timely manner in case of issue. You are able to work independently & in a team in a transnational environment You are able to communicate effectively (oral, writing & presentation) You are able to accept responsibility of task and hold signature delegation.
