title: Data Scientist
jobDescription: The Airbus India Innovation Centre (AIC) is at the forefront of the company’s digital transformation, particularly within the Innovation and Engineering departments. As we move towards Industrialisation of AI, the department focuses on applying Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, and Deep Tech to solve critical aerospace challenges—ranging from generative design and predictive maintenance to autonomous systems. In this fast-paced environment, the Innovation Team acts as an internal incubator for disruptive technologies. Our projects follow a rigorous lifecycle from Proof of Concept (PoC) to full industrial deployment. To support these goals, AIC seeks to onboard a Data Scientist to explore ill-defined complex business problems around data using scientific methods and to transform them into insights solutions based on state of the art machine learning, AI and statistics with the focus on forward-looking applications. The Data Scientist will work closely with AI lead and Product Managers to ensure data integrity throughout the product life cycle. Job Description: Understand and translate business needs into statistical, machine learning, or AI problem spaces. Collaborate with IT and Data Analysts to extract and integrate structured and unstructured data from various sources. Work closely with Data Engineers to design scalable data pipelines and ensure efficient data flow for model training and evaluation. Analyze data properties and apply scientific methods to propose or develop solutions using statistical, machine learning, or AI techniques. Design and execute controlled experiments to identify and validate optimal solutions. Implement solutions using state-of-the-art algorithms and software engineering best practices. Create monitoring protocols to ensure models align with evolving business needs. Contribute to the development and reusability of industrial-grade AI solutions. Share best practices, insights, and techniques with the wider data community. Ensure compliance with all external and internal regulations and standards. Develop solutions responsibly in line with Airbus ethical AI principles Key Competencies: Competency & Skill Level AI: Machine Learning & Deep Learning : 3 - Advanced Level Artificial Intelligence (AI) Approaches : 3 - Advanced Level Applied probabilities & Statistics : 3 - Advanced Level Software engineering fundamentals : 2 - Autonomous Level Data Governance Management System : 2 - Autonomous Level Data Science: Advanced Analytics : 3 - Advanced Level Data Science: Data visualisation & Coms : 3 - Advanced Level Data Science: Data Wrangling : 3 - Advanced Level Data Security : 1 - Basic Level Generative AI Essentials & Prompting : 3 - Advanced Eco-design & Sustainability of Digital services : 2 - Autonomous Level Competency Scale: Basic Level: Basic level of expertise, performs routine and/or recurrent tasks, implies partial supervision. Autonomous Level : Ability to solve problems autonomously, no supervision required in these tasks. Can deal with unforeseen issues. Advanced Level: High Level of knowledge and wide experience which is internally recognised. Could be a mentor/coach/advisor to support skill development of other colleagues Education and Experience: Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative technical field (Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Aerospace Engineering). A Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field (e.g., Physics, Mathematics, Aerospace Engineering, or Computer Science) is an advantage. Industry Tenure: 8+ years of experience in data-related roles, with a proven track record of leading technical teams through the full AI project lifecycle. Advanced knowledge of modern architectures, including CNNs and Transformers. Hands-on experience with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and hybrid modeling approaches is an advantage Proficiency with GenAI toolkits such as Hugging Face, LangChain, and LlamaIndex, alongside agentic frameworks (e.g., Google ADK). Expert-level coding in Python and deep familiarity with the ecosystem (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn). Expert knowledge of SQL and database systems (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle), including terminal-based workflows (e.g., Claude Code). Subject matter expertise in aviation datasets (flight data, maintenance records, passenger telemetry) and business processes is definite advantage Practical knowledge of containerization and cloud/on-premise deployment to ensure models move from research to production. The ability to translate complex model outputs into "The Story Behind the Data" for non-technical global stakeholders. Ability to operate within a Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring all code and research is reproducible, audit-ready, and meets "aircraft-grade" standards. Comfortable with a "fail-fast" innovation mindset while maintaining the rigorous safety and quality requirements of the aerospace industry. Experience working cross-functionally with AI Engineers and Product Managers for End-to-End delivery. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. jobDescription: Feeling ready to spread your wings ? What if your adventure started with us ?! Whatever your dream job, we might have the Apprenticeship for you ! Are you a fresh graduate looking for an opportunity that will launch your career? Imagine yourself at the heart of an internationally recognized company, established on every continent, and rich in diverse backgrounds, expertise, and cultures. Focused on digital and at the forefront of research and innovation, you have the opportunity to be part of this exciting adventure. Your mission: An apprenticeship opportunity titled : « Apprentice- HR Commercial & Customer Services » has just opened at Airbus India located in Delhi, India You will join the HR department in charge of One Roof. Ideally, this is a 12-month program and it should start in 1st July 2026 (date subject to flexibility). Your main missions will consist of : 1. Strategic Onboarding & Cultural Induction Experience Design: Use creativity to reinvent our onboarding journey. Move beyond checklists to create "wow" moments for new hires. Brand Ambassadorship: Facilitate high-energy induction sessions that serve as the first touchpoint for our employer brand. Continuous Improvement: Audit the 30-60-90 day experience, using feedback to iterate and improve retention. 2. Special Projects: I&D, Talent, & Engagement Inclusion & Diversity (I&D): Research and launch creative initiatives that move I&D from "policy" to "practice" within the business units. Talent Development: Partner with the Sr. HRBL to design bespoke development programs, identifying skill gaps and creative ways to bridge them. Engagement Strategy: Collaborate with business leaders to execute engagement calendars that aren't just "events," but meaningful culture-shifters. 3. Data Analytics & Predictive Modeling Workforce Intelligence: Analyze workforce strength, attrition trends, and productivity metrics. Pattern Prediction: Use data to forecast future talent needs and identify potential flight risks before they happen. Dashboarding: Maintain high-level HR dashboards that provide "at-a-glance" health checks for the leadership team. 4. Executive Communication & Presentation The "Story" Behind the Data: Translate complex workforce analytics into clear, visually stunning executive presentations (PPT, Canva, or interactive dashboards). Leadership Interaction: Present insights and project updates directly to senior stakeholders, demonstrating high levels of professional presence and "executive voice." Creative Comms: Draft internal communications that are engaging, punchy, and aligned with our corporate identity. Your tutor will support you identify your professional objectives and develop your skills This apprenticeship will allow you to develop the following skills: Strategic Business Partnering: Moving from administrative HR to becoming a "strategic advisor" by aligning people initiatives with business P&L and growth goals. Data Storytelling & Predictive Analytics: Learning to go beyond reporting numbers to predicting workforce trends (attrition, hiring gaps) and presenting them as actionable business insights. Executive Presence: Mastering the art of high-stakes communication, learning how to pitch complex ideas and "Special Projects" to C-suite and senior stakeholders. End-to-End Experience Design: Applying Design Thinking to the employee lifecycle—specifically reinventing onboarding and engagement to drive retention. Change Management: Navigating the complexities of implementing I&D and Talent Development programs across diverse business units. title: Solution Innovator
jobDescription: Job Description - Solution Innovator About the Team & Department Digital Innovation is at the forefront of shaping the future of Customer Services Digital Solutions. Our mission is to lead the end-to-end co-creation of groundbreaking digital solutions, addressing the primary needs of the Air Transport System from idea to MVP maturity. We achieve this through an Open Innovation and Co-Creation process, leveraging Airbus's unique assets, hands-on experience, and proven methodologies like Design Thinking, Lean UX, Lean Start-up, and (Scaled) Agile. We support the transformation of different Airbus customer services business lines by supporting them through specific missions. You will be an integral part of the Innovation for Digital Solutions team, a dynamic group of Strategic Designers, Value Architects, and Solution Innovators organized into Digital Growth Squads. Our core activity revolves around identifying new solutions to help our customers solve complex problems and unlock significant business value by designing desirable, viable, and feasible services. Co-creation, Design Thinking, and Lean UX are embedded in our daily philosophy and ways of working. Role Purpose As a Solution Innovator, you will drive the development of innovative digital solutions, bridging customer needs, business value, and technical feasibility. This pivotal role focuses on leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and advanced software development, to define and operationalize disruptive new services that meet critical demands within the aerospace context. Key Responsibilities AI-Driven Prototyping & Development: Lead the conceptualization, design, and development of technical prototypes, with a strong focus on Artificial Intelligence, particularly Generative AI, to de-risk technology bricks and validate solution feasibility. Actively identify, learn, and apply new and emerging AI technologies (e.g., Machine Learning, Multi-agent systems) to address customer needs and drive innovation. Drive the vision and foster a network around the strategic usage of Generative AI for Customer Services. Aerospace Business Context Integration: Apply a deep understanding of the aerospace business context, including Aircraft Maintenance domains, Fleet Performance, and Aircraft Configuration and Data, to identify and define high-impact digital solutions. Translate complex operational challenges within the air transport industry into innovative technical solutions that enhance predictability and resilience of airline operations. Support squads in establishing innovation roadmaps where AI is a key enabler for in-service maintenance and operations, including Prognostic Health Monitoring. Feasibility Assessment & Management: Rigorously assess the feasibility of proposed solutions across operational, technical, schedule, economic, legal, and sustainability axes. Work closely with Strategic Design and Early Adopters to understand user personas, pain points, and journeys, and gather solution feedback through various testing methods. Collaborate with Value Architects to assess the potential value a solution could generate for customers and Airbus. Define the key features of the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) in collaboration with Product Owners, developing capability and feature lists and user stories. Strategic & Collaborative Innovation: Actively participate in Ideation Sessions, Brainstorms, Creative Thinking workshops, and Design Sprints to qualify and select high-potential ideas aligned with strategic intent. Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams including Strategic Designers, Value Architects, Digital Architects, Business & Functional Architects, and ad-hoc experts to scope, design, and deliver innovative solutions. Perform continuous technology watch and scouting to identify emerging technologies and new trends relevant to digital services in the aerospace industry. Contribute to the development of business cases and operating plans, including cost structure evaluations and defining global roadmaps and budgets for future technical solutions. Project & Stakeholder Management: Drive the multidisciplinary team through lean, agile-based incubation and early adoption processes (Build, Learn, Adapt). Prepare and conduct handovers to industrialization teams, ensuring comprehensive support and technical documentation (user guides, training material, operations dossiers). Work closely with data governance to define and maintain principles of data governance (e.g., GDPR, Export Control) and actively identify measures to protect intellectual property. Required Skills & Competencies Technical Expertise: Proven hands-on skills in quickly prototyping and developing software solutions, with a strong emphasis on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, ideally including Generative AI. Strong understanding of mobile, cloud, and web technologies. Experience with functional architecture and modeling languages. Ability to conceptualize and implement technical & functional integration between complementary software products. Aerospace Domain Knowledge: Demonstrated understanding of the Air Transport industry and specific knowledge of Aircraft Maintenance domains, Fleet Performance, and Aircraft Configuration and Data. Ability to identify the application of technology to complex business problems within the aerospace sector. Innovation & Strategic Thinking: An entrepreneurial drive to define and develop new solutions, coupled with an ability to think strategically and creatively. Working knowledge of agile development methodologies (Lean Start-up, Scrum, Kanban). Customer-minded, challenging, curious, and open-minded approach to problem-solving. Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Superior interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence through persuasive written and verbal communication. Excellent leadership skills with experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. Ability to set and manage expectations at the senior leadership level. Organizational & Problem-Solving: Capacity for self-motivation, independent initiative, and creative problem-solving. Diligent attention to detail and strong technical intuition. Ability to manage time and schedules to meet aggressive deadlines. Autonomous and self-organized with strong problem-solving capabilities. Data & IP Management: Ability to understand and manage data sensitivity and classification such as GDPR and export compliance. Qualifications A Master's degree from an accredited educational institution in a technical discipline (Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, or a related field) or equivalent working experience as a Functional/Technical Architect or Senior Developer on cutting-edge solutions. What We Offer At Airbus, we foster a culture that encourages flexibility, collaboration, and continuous innovation. This is a unique opportunity to directly impact the future of aerospace, delivering significant value by creating groundbreaking digital services that resolve critical customer pain points within a highly dynamic and innovative environment. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. title: Senior Full Stack Data Engineer - Methods & Tools
jobDescription: Senior Full Stack Data Engineer - Methods & Tools Team: Airbus India - Engineering Methods & Tools About the team: We are a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in a multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems. The team is composed of people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing the latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have. Some examples of the digital solutions are Data driven designs of wiring, Automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based products aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. We are also involved in developing web-based solutions to encapsulate and automate different workflows such as flight test planning, business management etc. In addition to these, developing tools for Electrical Wiring Harness and Hydraulic Circuit design process improvements. Some of the tools developed are used in the areas of Aircraft Safety analysis and Engineering Business Data monitoring etc. We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a Full Stack Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining our data infrastructure and systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to implement scalable data solutions that drive actionable insights and support our business objectives. Responsibilities: Design and develop robust data pipelines to collect, clean, transform, and store data from diverse sources. Build scalable data models and databases to support applications, analytics, and reporting. Implement efficient ETL processes to ensure data quality and integrity. Develop APIs and microservices for seamless data integration across platforms. Optimize and tune databases and queries for maximum performance and reliability. Ensure compliance with data security and privacy regulations.

Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). title: Synthetic Flight Instructor
jobDescription: Position : Synthetic Flight Instructor Company: Airbus India Training Centre, Gurugram Note : The position is for the newly formed joint venture company between Airbus & Air India. The joint venture company will be called Airbus India Training Centre (AITC) Delivering on its commitment to ‘Skill India’, Airbus has entered into a 50:50 joint venture with the Tata-owned Air India to launch a world-class pilot training centre in Gurugram, Haryana. The JV Training Centre will offer A320 and A350 flight training to some 5,000 new pilots over 10 years. This joint venture, named as Airbus India training centre (AITC) will be a strategically critical project for both organizations, with an ambition to form a world leading Aviation Academy in South Asia that could positively impact operations and safety standards of both Airbus and Air India operators in the region. Position : SFI Location : Gurgaon, Haryana Employment: The incumbent will be a position holder of the JV legal entity, Company name - Airbus India Training Centre Job Description: You will Instruct airline crews converting to Airbus on all operational and technical aspects for a specific type (or types) using: Fixed Base Simulators, Classroom, Airbus Pilots Training Devices Full Flight Simulators You will give stand-up lectures in order to ensure airline crews capability to carry out safely and correctly all normal and emergency procedures required by Airworthiness authorities so that the crew will achieve the required level of standard proficiency. You will adhere to Airbus standard policy and standardization as required by Airbus Flight Training Operations. You will instruct the crews within the defined time limits. You will evaluate the crews’ progression. You will decide, need be, on the necessity to give any extra session to achieve the level of proficiency. Task & accountabilities : You will be responsible for the following activities: Instruct crews using the above mentioned training devices Deliver if required (and after being indoctrinated) others specific courses ( ETOPS, performance etc.) Need be, participate in courses development or in standardization instruction. Required skills : You have acquired 3000 hours of total flight time as pilot with minimum 1500 flight hours on multi-pilot aircraft (MPA). You hold or have held an EASA and/or DGCA ATPL License. You have or have held a type rating on Airbus aircraft is a plus. A Synthetic Flight Instructor Authorization or experience as Instructor would be a plus. A negotiation level of English is required for this position. You are recognised for your pedagogy, your perseverance, your flexibility, your curiosity and your adaptability. You are available for business trips worldwide. title: Data Scientist - Air Systems
jobDescription: Role: The Job Holder will act as a Data Scientist on Air System applications with the task to provide safe and balanced designs in face of opposing interests and multiple, sometimes conflicting constraints, like Performance, Cost, Environmental, Industrial and Operational Requirements. The Job Holder will play a key role in developing machine learning and deep learning based models, for predictive and prescriptive decision-making, using in-service data and design data, while being able to build analytics dashboards to analyze aircraft (Air-systems) operational reliability. The Job Holder needs to provide a link between the Air Systems and other groups at Airbus that perform Data Analytics, Predictive Maintenance and gather data from Airbus databases/tools (Skywise / Palantir), to create business intelligence. - Understand and translate business needs into statistical, machine learning, or AI problem spaces. - Collaborate with IT and Data Analysts to extract and integrate structured and unstructured data from various sources. - Work closely with Data Engineers to design scalable data pipelines and ensure efficient data flow for model training and evaluation. - Analyze data properties and apply scientific methods to propose or develop solutions using statistical, machine learning, or AI techniques. - Design and execute controlled experiments to identify and validate optimal solutions. - Implement solutions using state-of-the-art algorithms and software engineering best practices. - Create monitoring protocols to ensure models align with evolving business needs. - Contribute to the development and reusability of industrial-grade AI solutions. - Share best practices, insights, and techniques with the wider data community. - Ensure compliance with all external and internal regulations and standards. - Develop solutions responsibly in line with Airbus ethical AI principles. Technical Skills: Key Skills ❖ Machine learning, Deep learning code development and deployment ❖ Dashboarding in Skywise environments and standalone tools ❖ Experience in building NLP, Time series, Computer Vision & physics based surrogate models ❖ Data driven and hybrid (physics + data) modeling based decision science ❖ Experience in Management of different stakeholders: ➢ Customers (Programs, Customer Service), ➢ Stakeholder from different functions (other Engineering teams, Procurement, Production, Customer Service, Quality, Config Mgmt) Soft Skills ● Teamwork and excellent communication skills ● Willingness to learn new skills, self-development and Problem-solving orientation ● Capability to manage conflicts and negotiation Skills ● Manage Stakeholder’s requirements and deliver high-quality results on-time Qualification: Masters or Bachelors degree in Aerospace/Mechanical/Applied Math or related streams. title: IT Operations Specialist
jobDescription: Position Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and motivated IT Operations Specialist to join our growing team. This entry-level role is perfect for someone looking to kickstart their career in IT operations while keeping our business running smoothly behind the scenes. In this role, you will split your time between foundational IT support (monitoring systems, basic troubleshooting, and user setup) and critical data entry operations (maintaining databases, logging technical inventory, and ensuring data accuracy). The ideal candidate has a passion for technology, an eagle eye for detail. Key Responsibilities IT & Systems Operations System Monitoring: Assist in monitoring performance, health, and data quality User Support & Provisioning: Help set up new hire workstations, configure accounts (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, etc.), and troubleshoot basic hardware/software issues. Asset Management: Track, log, and manage company IT inventory (laptops, monitors, licenses). Documentation: Maintain clear logs of IT support tickets, resolutions, and system updates. Data Entry & Administration Data Maintenance: Input, update, and maintain accurate records in our company databases Quality Assurance: Cross-reference and verify technical data for accuracy, identifying and correcting discrepancies. title: Certification Engineer - Avionics & Cabin Electronics
jobDescription: Job Summary We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Certification Engineer to join our Certification Technical Directorate team at Airbus India. This role will be responsible for ensuring the airworthiness and regulatory compliance of avionics and cabin electronic systems on Airbus aircraft, contributing to the safety and reliability of our products. Job scope (Tasks & accountabilities): The Jobholder exercises the Minor change approval legal privileges granted by EASA to Airbus in full compliance with Part 21 and Design organization Approval requirements, maintaining the Airbus privileges for design approval, ensuring on time approval for the permanent satisfaction of our customers (initial A/C deliveries and in service A/C design changes). The jobholder guarantees the Airworthiness of the design changes defined by Airbus, reporting airworthiness issue to a Chief Airworthiness Engineer. Main problems to be solved in the position: The requirements for the Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) for the Change Approval process are: Allocates the changes to him/herself in the Airbus tools (AirCAM) as Airworthiness mod leader Reviews the change dossier from the Design Office, classifies the change with regard to part 21 criteria within Airbus tool (ACC2). Appraises the design change, identifies the applicable requirements within Airbus tool (ICC) and verifies the compliance to applicable requirements provided by the Compliance Verification Engineer (CVE), if relevant. Completes the Modification Approval Summary in order to approve the Change within ICC, as Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) or communicate specific refusal to the CVE and Design responsible. Record the Change approval in Airbus tool (ACC2). Report issues in order to support the head of repair approval, for training or reporting or improvement on the repair approval. The Engineer must master the Airworthiness and technical knowledge covering the various changes he/she will have to approve as DAE. The changes cover most of Airbus commercial A/C programs requiring a knowledge on all concerned programs in term of airworthiness requirements but also design. The A/C delivery schedules drumbeat the activity, indeed the changes must be approved in due time to support A/C deliveries. When the change is for installation on an in service A/C the schedule is driven by the Service Bulletin targets. Means made available: Access to all the tools: Aircam, ACC2, ICC … Access to the Airworthiness Technical Directorate adequate share folders and drives Delegation process related documentation (and specific training). Major end purposes: Signature Delegation (Check / Approve/ Refuse) in order to deliver Change approvals in line with Programs expectations. Required Domain Expertise (skills): Graduate/Post Graduate Engineer (Aerospace / Avionics / Electronics/ Electrical Engineering) Avionic or Cabin System Engineer, widely experienced on Aircraft Avionics or Cabin Electronics system engineering knowledge, with an integrated view of the aircraft with the following requirements : The engineer has a proven experience on large aircraft avionics or cabin system, and preferably on Airbus products. This experience is gained from areas such as maintenance, support or design and the most appropriate is that of avionic or electrical system design engineer. Technically competent with the Design principles used to the compliance data. Exposure to Avionic and cabin systems design documents is an added advantage. Knowledge on airworthiness Part21subpart D and on EASA CS25/JAR25/FAR25 avionics and electrical systems requirements is an added advantage. These experiences will reinforce the back ground of the candidate, his/her capacity in understanding, integrated design and airworthiness of an aircraft. The position has an Airworthiness function, the following requirements are a plus: Engineer should be knowledgeable of the Airworthiness domain, on process product and technical requirements and integrated aircraft design, in addition should be able to question and to understand application of technical airworthiness requirements. Should have a sound knowledge of Product Design. Conversant with the roles and responsibilities of a Type Certificate holder operating under a Design Organization Approval granted by EASA. Experience in the various approval procedures (EASA Part 21 / CS / JAR / FAR). Experience: 7 -12 years. Soft skills: You are recognized for being a team player, autonomous and customer-oriented with strong communication skills. You have problem-solving approach You speak English. You are able to communicate with the team, to listen but you are able to decide on your own. You are able to alert your management in timely manner in case of issue. You are able to work independently & in a team in a transnational environment You are able to communicate effectively (oral, writing & presentation) You are able to accept responsibility of task and hold signature delegation. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. title: Buyer
jobDescription: Job Title / Role : Buyer – Corporate Services, General Procurement Location : Bengaluru, India Experience Level : 4 - 7+ years of experience in procurement roles Brief Description : The Buyer will be responsible for managing procurement activities for Corporate Services Commodity including areas like Business consulting, HR Services, Travel & Communication, Finance, Statutory Audit, M&A, Tax consulting, Company Car Lease, Employee wellness and benefit, Recruitment) for Airbus India & South Asia. The role focuses on implementing Airbus procurement processes, ensuring supplier lifecycle management and maintaining compliance, governance, and integrity. This is an individual contributor role, reporting directly to the Ho General Procurement (GP) – Airbus India & South Asia, and requires delivering projects within timelines and committed milestones. Key Roles & Responsibilities : 1. Procurement Strategy and Operations: Manage procurement activities across multiple sub-commodities, ensuring alignment with organization objectives and Airbus processes. Lead and execute the Call for Tender (CFT) process, including strategy definition, supplier engagement, negotiations and contract closure. Drive the supplier onboarding process, ensuring suppliers meet compliance, quality and performance criteria. Strategic Sourcing - Co-design with global commodity functions and business, support & drive Global Sourcing Strategy for the business and formulating the roadmap for the supply chain in India & the region. Governance - Define governance plans and track project / relationship health, to coordinate Multi Functional Teams, trans-national and / or trans-divisional covering various Airbus business entities. Procurement Marketing - Identify market trends, benchmark competitor strategies & monitor supplier landscape, propose business cases & solutions to improve value delivered from Indian supply chain capabilities. Call for tender Management - Lead cross-functional teams within the framework of local and global procurement projects - Involve further where required other relevant functions - Run the suppliers selection process, negotiation process, costing & contractual discussions. Lead & Execute procurement process with help of buyers and take end-to-end accountability for Corporate Services right from Sourcing to Ordering for Purchase of goods or services in line with specified cost, quality and delivery targets. Benchmarking: Develop Offshoring / Outsourcing models and solutions to contribute to the company’s strategy and goals as needed/requested by leadership. Risk mitigation and process optimization to enhance procurement efficiency. Perform Contract Management based on consistent and factual KPIs, evaluate and improve suppliers' performance in terms of time, costs and quality. Contribute to business case development (incl. validation of procurement baseline) Lead end-to-end relationship management for corporate service vendors, driving continuous improvement and maximizing value for the organization In the frame of risk management, assess suppliers' overall performance and initiate recovery actions Support management on deliveries, GRNs, and process returns to vendors. Provide advice and support to the business, understanding their requirements and guiding them to the most appropriate inventory and services. Prepare and maintain compelling and executive ready slides for weekly, monthly, quarterly and other ad-hoc executive briefings, reviews and other key meetings with stakeholders Drive compliant Airbus General Procurement processes and ensure implementation of rules, standards and business practice in accordance with Airbus policies. 2. Compliance and Integrity: Ensure adherence to procurement governance, ethical standards and Airbus compliance requirements. Monitor and mitigate risks related to fraud, non-compliance, and supplier governance. Enforce a structured approach to contract lifecycle management and supplier audits. 3. Supplier and Stakeholder Management: Build and sustain value-driven relationships with suppliers across various commodity domains. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, digital, consulting etc.) to deliver procurement projects within timelines and committed milestones. Work closely with internal & external stakeholders providing clarity on procurement status, KPIs, and risk assessments. 4. Focus on Timelines and Commitments: Ensure timely delivery of procurement activities and supplier engagements as per defined project schedules. Optimize workflows to enhance procurement efficiency and meet business-critical deadlines. Qualifications, Skill and Experience Levels Strong knowledge of procurement processes: sourcing, tendering (CFT), supplier onboarding, and contract management. Minimum 4 years of strategic sourcing experience. Specialized knowledge in HR Services, Tax Consulting, or Advisory Services is highly desirable. Proven track record in project/program management with at least 3 years of dedicated experience. Expert-level knowledge of strategic sourcing, commercial analysis, and end-to-end purchasing processes. Bachelor’s/B.Tech degree is a must. Preferred: MBA or Master’s in Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, or International Business. Expertise in managing multi-commodity procurement activities Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Strong compliance mindset with an ability to enforce governance and risk mitigation processes. Proven project management skills with a focus on timelines and delivery commitments. Highly analytical, results-oriented, and committed to optimizing procurement efficiency. Familiarity with ERP tools (e.g., SAP, Coupa..) and supplier management platforms. Ability to work with a high degree of independence while remaining a cohesive team player. Proven success working with remote management and colleagues across distributed global teams. A proactive, resilient, and assertive contributor who practices active listening and demonstrates self-awareness. Committed to ethical conduct, showing moral courage, transparency and honesty in all professional dealings. Fluent in English with the ability to convey complex information clearly (written and verbal) to stakeholders Proficiency in tools like MS Office, Google Workspace (Slides, Docs, Sheets) for daily operations and executive reporting. An optimistic and growth-oriented mindset with a strong willingness to learn. Travel Expectations - To effectively support our regional and global operations, this role requires a degree of mobility. Candidates must be prepared to undertake domestic and international travel as required for by business requirements. This position offers an opportunity for professional advancement within a dynamic, multi-disciplinary environment. Airbus encourages continuous learning, providing a platform to broaden your expertise across diverse functions and collaborate with high-performing teams. title: Digital Cybersecurity Quality Lead
jobDescription: Airbus is not just flying planes; we are pioneering the future of aerospace through a massive digital evolution. In the Digital Cybersecurity Transformation team, security is our bedrock. We are looking for a Quality & Operational Excellence Lead to be the strategic bridge between high-level security vision and world-class execution. This is a high-visibility role across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Portugal, and India. You won't just monitor compliance; you will shape the mindset of a global team. Why This Role? Global Influence: Gain direct visibility with Cybersecurity leadership, contributing your voice to the decisions that shape our digital future. Strategic Impact: You will be the guardian of excellence for projects that defend Airbus’s global digital frontier. Transformation: You aren't just adopting a process; you are the one evolving the Airbus Business Management system for a faster, smarter digital age. Key Responsibilities 1.Champion of Quality & Strategy The Quality Roadmap: Design and execute the strategy to embed a "Quality-First" culture across our global digital perimeter. Act as a strategic partner for Project Gate Reviews, ensuring our most critical security initiatives are delivered with uncompromised quality. Audit Leadership: Empower teams to stay "audit-ready". You will turn findings into growth opportunities, ensuring our global perimeter remains a model of excellence. 2. Governance & Change Catalyst Steer the CAB: Lead the Change Acceptance Board (CAB), collaborating with Architects to ensure technical changes are robust, secure, and ready for flight. The Voice of the Domain: As our Process Representative (POM), acts as the strategic link between operational reality and process design. You catch operational feedback and turn it into improved global ways of working. You make the system work better for everyone. 3. Resilience & Risk Intelligence Strategic Risk Support: Act as the "early warning system" for the domain. You’ll guide project teams in identifying and mitigating risks before they impact the business. Root Cause Leadership: When challenges arise, you’ll lead the analysis to find the "why" and build the bridge to the "how" for future prevention. 4. Performance Storytelling & Insights The Pulse of the Domain: You won’t just report numbers; you’ll tell the story of our success. By tracking Top Function and Domain Objectives, you provide the leadership team with the clarity they need to celebrate wins and pivot where necessary. Qualifications & Experience Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, Business, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience. The Experience: 3+ years of experience in Quality Management, Operational Excellence, or Project Governance. You have a track record of turning standards into tangible results. The Analytical Mind: You have a natural knack for identifying project risks and the confidence to suggest proactive solutions to leadership. The Communicator: You are an expert at building bridges in multicultural environments. You thrive on collaboration and can influence stakeholders at all levels with clarity and empathy. The Digital Edge: You move at the speed of Digital, with a solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or Kanban). The Purpose: You are driven by ethics and a desire to contribute to the safety and security of the global aerospace industry. Success Metrics Effective implementation/coordination of cybersecurity projects, ensuring security objectives align with business needs. Improved stakeholder collaboration, driving engagement and alignment across teams. Optimized processes, resulting in improved risk mitigation and operational efficiency. title: Customer Support Manager
jobDescription: 1. Mission The Customer Support Manager (CSM) is Customer’s focal point regarding Support & Services, accountable for customer satisfaction and driving continuous improvement to guarantee global services performance for the customer and increase fleet availability, covering the entirety of the customer’s fleet. In order to carry out this mission, the CSM will: ● Coordinate support disciplines & experts, in order to bring a quick and adequate solution to customer needs in priority and/or exceptional cases ● Set up and follow up any operational action plan to deal with customer concerns, complaints and/or dissatisfaction ● Collect customer satisfaction, needs or expectations to relay the customer context for further use within AH ● Build customer satisfaction and confidence to enable business growth. ● Ensure overall performance in terms of parts availability (new and repaired) as part of the front office. 2. Main Activities The CSM’s main activities are: ● To contribute in the definition of the key objectives of the Customer Satisfaction Roadmap for customers in their customer portfolio Develop a customer strategy that is aligned with the Customer’s expectations and shared with the other members of the Front Office Team, followed in the CRM Salesforce ● To organize regular meetings/visits with customers in their customer portfolio Listen to and exchange with the Customer to recover the customer’s priorities (such as availability, spares delivery, focal point responsiveness, maintenance duration) needed to define the customer strategy, as well as their feedback and priority issues relating to operational performance (prepare necessary reports presenting key data for the end customer), followed in the CRM Salesforce ● To provide customer with key information on support and services Communicate S&S Discipline contents to the Customer on hot topics, performance, improvement initiatives, services catalog key changes, and recommendations for mutual benefit Guide the customer by helping them to understand our products and organization better, and improving the way we work with them ● To collect, discuss and manage customer feedback and knowledge Collect customer feedback on S&S interactions since last exchange, review progress on current action plan, recover customer perceptions on latest hot topics, recover customer needs and activity forecasts at strategic and operational level, followed in the CRM Salesforce ● To listen, understand and propose any required actions on Customer priority and/or exceptional issues Understand the customer priority and/or exceptional issues that may occur and require immediate action through transverse management of S&S disciplines and ensure each of them respect their commitments through to resolution, followed in the CRM Salesforce As the customer’s preferred focal point for S&S, escalate if and where needed to jobDescription: Job Description Engineer - Methods & Tools (Data Analyst) About the team: It is a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in a multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems. The USP of the team is people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing the latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have. Some examples of the digital solutions for various Core Engineering departments such as Data driven designs of wiring, automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based products aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. It also involves developing web-based solutions to encapsulate and automate different workflows such as flight test planning etc. In addition to these points, developing tools for Electrical Wiring Harness and Hydraulic Circuit design process improvements. Some of the tools developed; are used in the areas of Aircraft Safety analysis and Engineering Business Data monitoring etc. M&T is also deeply involved in Agile Scrum and SAFe in developing state of the art digital products for the areas mentioned above. About the Role We are seeking a detail-oriented PLM Data Analyst to join our Methods and Tools team. In this role, you will be responsible for curating, analyzing, and transforming data from our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems to drive business insights. You will work extensively with our main data platforms, including Palantir Foundry to build curated data products, dashboards, data insights for our engineering business. Key Responsibilities: Data Analysis & Reporting: Query and analyze complex PLM datasets related to product structures, bills of materials (BOMs), change and release management, and quality metrics. Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Palantir Foundry (using Contour, Workshop, Quiver) and other analytics tools. Data Integration and Curation: Assist in data ingestion, cleansing, and transformation within Foundry, linking PLM data with other business systems (e.g., ERP, MES). Process Improvement: Identify data quality issues, data gaps, and process bottlenecks within the product lifecycle. Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering and IT teams to understand their data requirements and provide analytical support. Required Qualifications & Skills: Experience: 6+ years experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in an engineering, or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) focused environment. Data Engineering Skills: Proven experience in building and maintaining data pipelines, data models, and ETL/ELT processes. Palantir Foundry Experience: Hands-on experience developing data pipelines and analytics in Foundry. Proficiency with Pipeline Builder, Code Workbooks (Python/SQL), and Contour/Workshop/Quiver is essential. SQL Proficiency: Strong command of SQL for complex queries, joins, and data manipulation. Data Modeling: Strong understanding of data modeling principles and the ability to apply them to create logical and physical data models for PLM data. Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities. PLM Knowledge: Familiarity with core PLM concepts and data (e.g., BOMs, engineering change management, product lifecycle states). Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to non-technical stakeholders. Agile Proficiency: Good to have experience working in Agile frameworks such as SAFe and Scrum.
